Gao Hongjie Intelligent Equipment (Guangdong) Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Dongguan, Guangdong, with annual revenue exceeding 200 million yuan. It operates two production bases: one in Zhongkai High-Tech Zone, Huizhou, Guangdong, and one in Ninh Bình Province, Vietnam. The company is a Tier 1 supplier to leading industry customers and focuses on the R&D, manufacturing, and sales of advanced thermal management equipment, aiming to build industry-leading heat dissipation solutions. The headquarters has more than 150 employees. The core team has worked in the thermal management field for many years, and the main technical staff come from leading companies in the industry, with solid project execution and R&D capability.

Guangdong Baizan Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. was founded in 2012. It is a benchmark company in the vertical injection molding machine sector, with annual revenue exceeding 300 million yuan. It has two production bases in Jiangmen, Guangdong, and Huzhou, Zhejiang, with a mature manufacturing system and a strong market foundation. Baizan Intelligent and Gao Hongjie have joined forces to expand the liquid cooling industry chain horizontally and upgrade it vertically. Relying on mature capacity and high-quality customer resources, the two companies are working together to continuously improve the group's overall competitiveness in the liquid cooling track.

Guangdong Baizan Gaohongjie Liquid Cooling Equipment Co., Ltd. is located in Songshan Lake, Dongguan, and is the core entity of the group focused on the liquid cooling track. The company has attracted top industry talent and has reached strategic cooperation agreements with several leading companies. It adheres to independent innovation and has a 10,000-class (ISO 7) lab and testing center. Its annual R&D investment is not less than 5 million yuan, and it continues to focus on heat sink assembly and performance testing.

The product lineup is broad, covering liquid cooling heat sink assembly equipment, fan assembly equipment, heat pipe assembly and test equipment, VC (vapor chamber) assembly and test equipment, liquid cooling inspection equipment, and AI vision inspection equipment. These testing devices can complete liquid cooling component cleaning, leak detection, and flow resistance and thermal resistance performance testing in one stop. They address pain points in liquid cooling plate mass production such as clogging, leakage, and failure to meet heat dissipation performance, and are suited to liquid cooling applications including computing servers, data centers, and new energy.

Leveraging the group's synergies, Baizan Gaohongjie combines its heat dissipation technology expertise with precision manufacturing capability. It can provide standardized equipment as well as customized production line solutions, helping customers stabilize yield and improve inspection efficiency. Going forward, the company will continue to focus on the liquid cooling equipment track, refine equipment precision, and aim to build a technology stronghold in liquid cooling heat dissipation equipment, providing reliable equipment support for the scaled development of the liquid cooling industry.

高宏杰智能装备（广东）有限公司总部坐落于广东东莞，年营收超 2 亿元，在广东惠州仲恺开发区与越南宁平省设有两大生产基地。企业深度绑定行业头部客户，成为其一级供应商，专注先进散热装备的研发、生产与销售，致力于打造行业领先的散热解决方案。总部现有员工 150 余人，核心团队深耕散热领域多年，主力技术人员均来自行业头部企业，具备扎实的项目落地与技术研发能力。

广东百赞智能装备有限公司创立于 2012 年，是立式注塑机领域标杆企业，年营收突破 3 亿元，在广东江门、浙江湖州布局两大生产基地，制造体系成熟、市场根基深厚。百赞智能与高宏杰强强联合，推动液冷产业链横向拓展、纵向升级，依托成熟产能与优质客户资源协同发力，持续提升集团在液冷赛道的综合竞争力。

广东百赞高宏杰液冷设备有限公司位于东莞松山湖，是集团主攻液冷赛道的核心主体。公司广纳行业顶尖人才，已和多家头部企业达成战略合作。企业坚持自主创新，建有万级实验检测中心，每年研发投入不低于 500 万元，持续深耕散热器组装与性能测试领域。

公司产品矩阵丰富，覆盖液冷散热器组装设备、风扇组装设备、热管组装测试设备、VC 组装测试设备、液冷检测设备以及 AI 视觉检测设备。各类检测设备可一站式完成液冷组件清洗、检漏、流阻热阻性能测试等工序，解决液冷板量产中的堵塞、渗漏、散热性能不达标等痛点，适配算力服务器、数据中心、新能源等液冷应用场景。

依托集团协同优势，百赞高宏杰融合散热技术积累与精密制造实力，可提供标准化设备以及定制化产线方案，帮助客户稳定良率、提升质检效率。未来公司将持续深耕液冷装备赛道，打磨设备精度，致力打造液冷散热装备技术高地，为液冷产业规模化发展提供可靠装备支撑。
